about: The detection baseline (docs/STANDARDS.md §5, M0.2): the problems planted in tests/fixtures/baseline-app and how far EAOS finds each, in the golden trial's check (the app run, no assistant). 'found' is what the last recorded check reached: card (a fix card names it), finding (an engine or a screen recorded it, no card), missed. tools/detection_baseline.py refuses a check that finds any of them less; --record writes what a check found after it found more. tests/fixtures/baseline-clean is its clean twin (M6.0): the same app done right, on which no layer finding may appear.

problems.what: a request parameter runs in a shell (exec('ping -c 1 ' + host))
a Supabase service-role key written in the code
the same 18 lines in report.js and export.js
the reports screen fails as it draws (report.rows is undefined)
the account screen needs a sign-in (name and password, /api/login)
problems.why: missed 2026-10-23: the account screen answers 401 and draws its form; sign-in.json says not needed (M5.3)

problems.what: any signed-in person reads any order: /api/orders/:id never checks the owner (the read endpoint that returns another user's row, M6.0)
a screen talks to the database itself (pg in web/Orders.jsx)
the quantity limit of an order is checked only in the browser; the server stores any quantity
a secret-named setting shipped to the browser (VITE_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY)
a Supabase secret key (sb_secret_) in the built output
POST /api/orders creates an order with no sign-in check
the table public.notes has no row-level security
a policy lets anyone change any order (for update using (true))
DELETE /api/orders/:id writes and no test reaches it
